using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp;
using Volo.Abp.Internal.Telemetry;
using Volo.Abp.Internal.Telemetry.Constants;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Tests
{
    public class AbpApplicationBaseTests
    {
        private class TestAbpApplication : AbpApplicationBase
        {
            public TestAbpApplication(IServiceCollection services)
                : base(typeof(TestAbpApplication), services, null)
            {
            }

            public new IServiceProvider ServiceProvider => base.ServiceProvider;

            public async Task CallInitializeTelemetryTrackingAsync()
            {
                // Call the private method via reflection since it's private
                var method = typeof(AbpApplicationBase).GetMethod("InitializeTelemetryTracking", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                if (method == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("InitializeTelemetryTracking method not found");
                var task = (Task)method.Invoke(this, null)!;
                await task;
            }

            public new bool ShouldSendTelemetryData()
            {
                var method = typeof(AbpApplicationBase).GetMethod("ShouldSendTelemetryData", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                if (method == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("ShouldSendTelemetryData method not found");
                return (bool)method.Invoke(this, null)!;
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task InitializeTelemetryTracking_CallsCreateScopeAndAddActivityAsync()
        {
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            var telemetryServiceMock = new Mock<ITelemetryService>();
            telemetryServiceMock.Setup(x => x.AddActivityAsync(ActivityNameConsts.ApplicationRun)).Returns(Task.CompletedTask).Verifiable();

            var serviceScopeMock = new Mock<IServiceScope>();
            serviceScopeMock.SetupGet(x => x.ServiceProvider).Returns(new ServiceCollection()
                .AddSingleton(telemetryServiceMock.Object)
                .BuildServiceProvider());

            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(x => x.CreateScope()).Returns(serviceScopeMock.Object);

            services.AddSingleton(serviceProviderMock.Object);

            var app = new TestAbpApplication(services);
            app.SetServiceProvider(serviceProviderMock.Object);

            await app.CallInitializeTelemetryTrackingAsync();

            telemetryServiceMock.Verify(x => x.AddActivityAsync(ActivityNameConsts.ApplicationRun), Times.Once);
            serviceProviderMock.Verify(x => x.CreateScope(), Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Volo.Abp;
using Volo.Abp.Internal.Telemetry;
using Volo.Abp.Internal.Telemetry.Constants;
using Xunit;

namespace Volo.Abp.Tests
{
    public class AbpApplicationBaseTests
    {
        private class TestAbpApplication : AbpApplicationBase
        {
            public TestAbpApplication(IServiceCollection services)
                : base(typeof(TestAbpApplication), services, null)
            {
            }

            public void SetServiceProviderForTest(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
            {
                // Use reflection to call the protected SetServiceProvider method
                var method = typeof(AbpApplicationBase).GetMethod("SetServiceProvider", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                if (method == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("SetServiceProvider method not found");
                method.Invoke(this, new object[] { serviceProvider });
            }

            public async Task CallInitializeTelemetryTrackingAsync()
            {
                var method = typeof(AbpApplicationBase).GetMethod("InitializeTelemetryTracking", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                if (method == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("InitializeTelemetryTracking method not found");
                var task = (Task)method.Invoke(this, null)!;
                await task;
            }

            public bool CallShouldSendTelemetryData()
            {
                var method = typeof(AbpApplicationBase).GetMethod("ShouldSendTelemetryData", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                if (method == null) throw new InvalidOperationException("ShouldSendTelemetryData method not found");
                return (bool)method.Invoke(this, null)!;
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task InitializeTelemetryTracking_CallsCreateScopeAndAddActivityAsync()
        {
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            var telemetryServiceMock = new Mock<ITelemetryService>();
            telemetryServiceMock.Setup(x => x.AddActivityAsync(ActivityNameConsts.ApplicationRun)).Returns(Task.CompletedTask).Verifiable();

            var serviceProviderForScope = new ServiceCollection()
                .AddSingleton(telemetryServiceMock.Object)
                .BuildServiceProvider();

            var serviceScopeMock = new Mock<IServiceScope>();
            serviceScopeMock.SetupGet(x => x.ServiceProvider).Returns(serviceProviderForScope);

            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(x => x.CreateScope()).Returns(serviceScopeMock.Object);

            var app = new TestAbpApplication(services);
            app.SetServiceProviderForTest(serviceProviderMock.Object);

            await app.CallInitializeTelemetryTrackingAsync();

            telemetryServiceMock.Verify(x => x.AddActivityAsync(ActivityNameConsts.ApplicationRun), Times.Once);
            serviceProviderMock.Verify(x => x.CreateScope(), Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void ShouldSendTelemetryData_ReturnsExpectedValue()
        {
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            var abpHostEnvironmentMock = new Mock<IAbpHostEnvironment>();
            abpHostEnvironmentMock.Setup(x => x.IsDevelopment()).Returns(true);

            var configurationMock = new Mock<IConfiguration>();
            configurationMock.Setup(x => x.GetValue<bool?>("Abp:Telemetry:IsEnabled")).Returns(true);

            var serviceProviderForScope = new ServiceCollection()
                .AddSingleton(abpHostEnvironmentMock.Object)
                .AddSingleton(configurationMock.Object)
                .BuildServiceProvider();

            var serviceScopeMock = new Mock<IServiceScope>();
            serviceScopeMock.SetupGet(x => x.ServiceProvider).Returns(serviceProviderForScope);

            var serviceProviderMock = new Mock<IServiceProvider>();
            serviceProviderMock.Setup(x => x.CreateScope()).Returns(serviceScopeMock.Object);

            var app = new TestAbpApplication(services);
            app.SetServiceProviderForTest(serviceProviderMock.Object);

            var result = app.CallShouldSendTelemetryData();

            Assert.True(result);
            serviceProviderMock.Verify(x => x.CreateScope(), Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}
